concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: one refined logo concept board for CYMBA, a premium audio and neurotechnology company.
Primary request: explore a clean, modern identity that feels like sophisticated consumer technology, understated and human. The user rejected angular, chamfered, stencil-cut, aggressively futuristic logos as too techy. The sweet spot is contemporary and distinctive, with quiet technical precision.
Design a compact abstract symbol of two gently curved parallel strokes arranged to imply a C and a subtle acoustic resonance. Use only two strokes with consistent medium-bold thickness, restrained rounded terminals and beautifully balanced negative space. No full circles, no signal dot, no literal ear. The symbol must be simple and robust enough to engrave on a tiny earbud.
Pair with exact uppercase "CYMBA" in a refined humanist sans-serif, medium weight, natural readable proportions, gently rounded curves, careful optical spacing. Avoid excessively wide tracking. The brand should feel calm, polished and confident.
Composition: landscape board with uniform cool off-white #f5f5f7. One centered horizontal lockup in charcoal #1d1d1f, generous whitespace. Bottom quarter: same small standalone icon and exact same whole logo reversed off-white in a modest charcoal rectangle. Keep same geometry and stroke weight relationships across all instances.
Style: flat vector-like brand design with crisp edges.
Text: "CYMBA" only. No other words, headings, labels or captions.
Avoid: stencil cuts, chamfers, angular facets, sci-fi fonts, gaming logos, circuits, microchips, stock wifi symbols, medical crosses, brains, infinity symbols, leaves, lotus shapes, decorative gradients, glow, shadows, 3D, texture, stationery mockups.

Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: one refined logo concept board for CYMBA, a premium audio and neurotechnology company.
Primary request: a clean modern logo halfway between warm consumer technology and precise premium audio. The user rejected aggressively techy angular and stencil-cut logos. Create a softer, simple, distinctive symbol: a compact flowing lowercase-c-like loop with a single broad opening, formed from one continuous solid ribbon of nearly uniform weight. Subtle asymmetric curvature makes it unique and suggests sound in motion. Keep it graphic, balanced and flat, never a 3D ribbon or an infinity mark. Limit complexity; needs to work on an earbud.
Pair with exact lowercase wordmark "cymba" in a beautifully drawn medium-weight contemporary sans-serif. Natural proportions, rounded bowls, a crisp y and friendly but not playful character. Do not use a sci-fi or overly rounded bubble font.
Composition: landscape concept board on uniform cool off-white #f5f5f7. One large centered horizontal charcoal #1d1d1f logo. Along lower quarter show the exact same symbol small, and exact same complete logo reversed off-white on a modest charcoal rectangular swatch. Generous whitespace, optical balance, consistent design in every repetition.
Style: flat vector-like logo identity, sharp clean edges, sophisticated restraint.
Text (verbatim): "cymba" only; no headings, captions, explanations or slogans.
Avoid: sharp angular facets, cut-up lettering, stencil fonts, squared sci-fi lettering, brains, ears, leaves, wellness lotus logos, stock wifi, circuits, microchips, gradients, shine, shadows, 3D, texture, photographed objects.

Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: one refined typographic logo concept board for CYMBA, a premium audio and neurotechnology company.
Primary request: create a sophisticated, clean, contemporary CYMBA wordmark. This should feel like a premium consumer technology brand with a calm human character. The user found previous angular, segmented, stencil-like logos too techy; avoid all those devices.
No separate symbol. Exact uppercase text "CYMBA", custom medium-weight sans-serif letterforms with natural proportions and elegant optical kerning. The C and B have generous round curves, the Y junction has a tiny softened inner corner, the M has confident vertical stems, and the A retains a conventional crossbar. Aim for one cohesive, quietly distinctive family of letterforms with subtle optical modifications rather than conspicuous gimmicks. Not an ordinary default font, but not visibly futuristic. Warm precision, refined audio equipment, enduring simplicity.
Composition: landscape presentation on uniform cool off-white #f5f5f7. Center one large charcoal #1d1d1f wordmark with plenty of surrounding space. Along bottom quarter show the exact same wordmark smaller and exact same wordmark reversed in off-white on a modest charcoal rectangle. Letter shapes and proportions must match exactly across repetitions.
Style: flat vector-like identity artwork, very crisp edges, confident modern typography.
Text (verbatim): "CYMBA" only. No other words, labels, headlines or captions.
Avoid: separate icon, angular chamfers, stencil breaks, detached crossbars, exaggerated wide tracking, extended squared sci-fi letters, razor-thin fashion fonts, bubble letters, medical imagery, gradients, glows, shadows, texture, 3D and stationery mockups.
